thread:
Maya Patel: Hey team — I'm opening a PR to reorganize the Console/Observability samples folder. Goal: make trace-hook, dashboard, and cost-snippet examples easier to find and version alongside dashboards-v2 docs. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/482
Sam O'Neill: :eyes: nice. Can you include a short migration note for teams on dashboards v1 -> v2? We should call out the metric name changes and the default time window.
Maya Patel: Yup. Drafting a migration section under docs/console/migrations/dashboards-v2.md. Will add a short checklist for SDK users.
Priya Desai: Heads-up — we renamed the SDK param `trace_key` -> `traceKey` in the 0.8.0 release. Any samples that use the old name need a note or dual snippet.
Maya Patel: Good catch. I'll add a small compatibility snippet with both examples and a comment.
Diego Ramos: Also check the cost/latency breakdown snippet — we changed the cost API path. Current sample uses `/v1/costs` but it should be `/v2/costs/summary`.
Maya Patel: Thanks — will update.
Sam O'Neill: CI is flaky on the snippet linter right now, FYI. docs-bot flagged a formatting error in the YAML sample in another PR.
docs-bot: lint:docs-samples failed on file console/samples/tracing/README.md line 42. Use 2-space indentation for nested lists.
Maya Patel: I'll run the local linter and fix before pushing.
Priya Desai: For the trace hook example, can we add an explicit `trace_id` example and show how to send it in headers? Saves users time. Something like:
```
# example header
Authorization: Bearer <token>
X-Trace-Id: 123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426614174000
```
Diego Ramos: Add a small note about sampling rate defaults — folks assume full traces by default. Mention that sampling is 0.1 by default and link to runtime sampling docs.
Maya Patel: Will add. For the folder restructure I'm moving: `console/samples/{tracing,costs,dashboards}` -> `console/observability/{tracing,cost-breakdown,dashboards-v2}` and leaving symlinked index pages for backward compat.
Sam O'Neill: Prefer a deprecation notice rather than symlinks — easier to search. But keep index pages for now with a clear callout: "moved to ...".
Maya Patel: Ok I'll add deprecation banners in the old locations for 3 months and a redirect table in the top-level README.
qa-bot: checklist: run sample smoke tests, verify YAML lint, confirm snippet output matches expected trace keys, validate links (docs.redwood.ai/console/*).
Maya Patel: Running smoke locally, hitting one failure in the cost sample: returned field `unit_cost` renamed to `cost_per_token`. Updating snippet and leaving a note in migration.md.
Priya Desai: When you push, ping me for a quick SDK snippet review — I can run the example with 0.8.0 and 0.7.x to ensure both work.
Maya Patel: Will do. ETA for push: today EOD. If CI passes, plan to merge tomorrow morning.
Sam O'Neill: Thanks — after merge can you open a follow-up PR to update the console TOC? We should surface the new observability folder in the navigation.
Maya Patel: Yep. Also adding a short 'what changed' blurb for the release notes.
Diego Ramos: One last thing — fix two stale links in docs/console/tracing/README.md that still point to the old tracing agent repo. I can send the replacements in a quick paste.
Maya Patel: Paste them here when ready.
Diego Ramos: Replacements: https://docs.redwood.ai/tracing/agent and https://docs.redwood.ai/observability/sampling
Maya Patel: Added both. Pushed branch, CI kicked off. Linking PR again: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/482
Sam O'Neill: :thumbsup: I'll monitor CI and merge if green.
Maya Patel: Thanks all — will ping back when merged and list out all changed paths for the release notes.
Priya Desai: Great, thanks Maya.
Maya Patel: End of thread.
